description: Plano, TX – February 9, 2026 – Judge Ben Smith, presiding judge of the 380th District Court and candidate for Justice on the Fifth Court of Appeals, celebrated a triumphant fundraiser on February 5, 2026, at the prestigious Harlan Crow Library in Dallas. The event, themed “Save the Court!!,” drew hundreds of enthusiastic supporters, featuring a live performance by renowned Texas country artist Pat Green and the presence of numerous dignitaries from the political and community spheres.The evening

title: Successful Fundraiser at Harlan Crow Library Bolsters Campaign for Judge Ben Smith
